name: Teemsun Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Teemsun Technology Co.,Ltd, engages in the research and development, production, sale, and service of infrared thermal imaging and other optoelectronics equipment in China. The company offers refrigeration infrared products, including detectors, core modules, complete units, and circuit modules, as well as cooled infrared detectors, uncooled infrared detectors, and infrared lenses. It is also involved in remote sensing data application, information system development, and navigation business. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Beijing, China.
